name: talking-head
label: Short-form edit of raw talking-head footage (sermon clip, teaching, vlog)

brief.Goal (one sentence): Turn raw talking-head takes into a tight vertical video that hooks in 2 seconds and keeps one idea.
brief.Deliverables: FootageEdit 9:16 (1080×1920; 4K if the footage is 4K), 30–60 s, pop captions; optional captions-free version
brief.Must-say copy / CTA: Speaker's name and role once (lower third); series name or CTA on the last line
brief.Audio: Clean voice first; optional music bed ducked under speech; −14 LUFS
brief.Look & feel references: Hook-first, jump cuts with punch-ins; look: bold (words behind the head), cool-girl or cool-dude, or classic pop captions (studio-edit §3c)

panels.title: Hook
panels.action: The strongest line in the footage, cold, first.

panels.title: Setup
panels.action: Context in the speaker's best take; fillers and dead air cut; lower third with name.

panels.title: Point
panels.action: The one idea; punch-in on every jump cut; pop-up on the key phrase or number.

panels.title: Close + CTA
panels.action: Strongest closing line; series name or CTA as a title.

hardRules: Never change what the speaker meant by cutting; no invented quotes.
Every cut on a word boundary or in a pause; zero audio pops (cutcheck).
Captions match the audio word for word, never cover the face, and stay out of the bottom 20% and right 12%.
visualNotes: Recipes: hook-2s + phone-first-volume. Template FootageEdit; edit lane in the studio-edit skill (transcribe → pack → autocut → edl → cutcheck).

motionVocabulary.name: Punch-in jump cut
motionVocabulary.how: autocut alternates zoom 1.0 / 1.12 on cuts inside one take, so the jump reads as intentional.

motionVocabulary.name: Pop captions
motionVocabulary.how: Max 3 words, Inter 900 uppercase with a black stroke; active word in the accent colour with a small spring pop.

motionVocabulary.name: Pop-up
motionVocabulary.how: White card with the key phrase, springs in above the face for 2–3 s (overlay kind popup).

qaChecklist: Hook plays in the first 2 s and is the strongest line.
cutcheck: no FAILs; any WARN explained.
Length within ±5 s of the target.
